summary: Reflected on the 2012 Knight Capital $440M deployment catastrophe, synthesizing deployment verification, immutable releases, and automated circuit breakers for production engineering.
evidence: Analyzed root causes of deployment failure: manual multi-server deployments, dormant dead code reactivation, reused feature flags, and lack of automated version consistency verification.

Formulated production deployment safeguards: immutable container artifacts (SHA-256 pinned images), atomic blue/green deployments with health and readiness checks, and backward-compatible expand-contract migrations.
Established automated circuit-breaker requirements: real-time velocity and volume anomaly monitoring, hard operational loss boundaries, and automated kill switches to halt rogue traffic in seconds.
